title: A simple pleasure, like olive oil
text: Thoroughly enjoyed our visit. Our guide was so friendly and knowledgeable. She took us first to the fields where the olives are grown and explained how the process is industrialised, then took us through the process of extracting the oil. A low-key but very enjoyable visit.  It's a fair way from Granada but you can't blame them from that!  Tasting session at the end was fascinating.
author: dramhampton

title: very modern mill
text: in our fondness for visiting mills and tasting olive oils I recommend this, super modern, looks like a robot factory! :-) I think they also sell it online on sites like oildelcampo.com and similar.
author: aceited
